personality_one_liner: An industrial-grade command center for site admins to track daily attendance, half-days, hourly overtime, and project payroll with absolute clarity.

spacing.rule: Generous touch spacing for outdoor site use with 8pt base grid and 56pt minimum interactive targets.

do's: Use solid contrast borders and dark tactical surfaces for extreme outdoor visibility under direct sunlight.
dont's: Never use low-contrast glass blur that reduces text legibility in dusty field conditions.

screens.name: Dashboard
screens.purpose: Overview of active project workforce, today's attendance breakdown (Full/Half/Absent), and running payroll liability.

states.loading: Skeleton card loader for active project stats and quick clock-in counters.
states.empty: No workers assigned to this project yet. Tap 'Manage Workers' to assign crew members.
states.error: Failed to sync attendance ledger. Check field connection and tap Retry.

screens.layout: Sticky site header with project switcher dropdown, live metric cards (Active Workers, Present Today, Running Payroll), quick action grid for attendance check-in, and recent attendance feed.

screens.name: Attendance Entry
screens.purpose: Fast daily check-in/out logging with support for Full-Day, Half-Day (Morning/Afternoon), and precise hourly overtime tracking.

states.loading: Loading worker list and active shift assignments...
states.empty: All workers have been checked in for today.
states.error: Could not record attendance. Please retry or save offline.

screens.layout: Searchable worker list for active project, instant status selector chips (Hadir Full / Setengah / Alpha), time-in/out pickers, and expandable overtime hour stepper.

screens.name: Workers & Rates
screens.purpose: Manage workforce directory, active project assignment, custom daily rates, half-day rates, and hourly overtime rates.

states.loading: Loading worker database and rate configurations...
states.empty: No workers registered. Add your first worker to get started.
states.error: Failed to load worker directory. Tap to retry.

screens.layout: Card list of workers with avatar/initials, active project badge, configured daily rate, half-day rate, and overtime rate per hour, with FAB to add new worker.

screens.name: Projects
screens.purpose: Manage active construction sites, location details, and assigned single active workforce.

states.empty: No projects created yet. Tap '+' to start a new project site.
states.error: Could not load projects. Please check connection.

screens.layout: Vertical list of project cards showing site name, location, active worker count, budget status, and tap-to-switch active project.

screens.name: Payroll Summary
screens.purpose: Automated payroll calculation combining daily/half-day attendance wages + hourly overtime rates, with payment status tracking (Unpaid / Paid).

states.loading: Calculating payroll ledger across active project...
states.empty: No attendance records found for this payroll cycle.
states.error: Failed to compute payroll summary. Tap to retry.

screens.layout: Date range picker, total payroll liability hero card, breakdown by worker (Days Worked + Overtime Hours x Rate = Total Pay), and one-tap 'Mark as Paid' action button.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure absolute field reliability and sunlight readability using the Dark-First Utility palette (#121417 background with warm amber #F59E0B accents). Implement sticky bottom navigation with 5 active tabs: Dashboard, Attendance, Workers, Projects, Payroll. Support admin-only workflow with strict one-worker-one-active-project rule. Ensure daily rate, half-day rate, and hourly overtime rate are clearly computed and editable in worker settings. All touch targets must be >= 44x44pt. Use exact token names from guidelines.json.
